registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Global control register for enabling the controller, selecting surrogate/mode policy, and issuing a one-cycle clear-fault semantic to the safety stage.

fields.name: enable
fields.description: Enables controller datapath operation when set.

fields.name: surrogate_select
fields.description: Selects the surrogate path policy used by transport/evaluator logic.

fields.name: mode_select
fields.description: Control mode selector for the transparent reference and surrogate comparison policy.

fields.name: clear_fault
fields.description: Write-one pulse that requests fault clear handling in the safety stage. This does not synthesize a fallback command.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
registers.description: Timeout threshold in controller cycles for response acceptance and stale/timeout monitoring.

fields.name: timeout_cycles
fields.description: Maximum allowed cycles before timeout handling inhibits actuator validity and latches fault state.

registers.name: STALE_LIMIT_CYCLES
registers.description: Freshness threshold in cycles for model-response staleness detection.

fields.name: stale_limit_cycles
fields.description: Maximum allowed response age before stale-data handling inhibits actuator validity and latches fault state.

registers.name: TILT_LIMIT
registers.description: Absolute actuator tilt bound used by surrogate/reference validation and final safety bounding.

fields.name: tilt_limit
fields.description: Signed-magnitude or bounded integer limit for tilt command magnitude; final commands are clamped within this envelope.

registers.name: DEFLECTION_LIMIT
registers.description: Absolute actuator deflection bound used by surrogate/reference validation and final safety bounding.

fields.name: deflection_limit
fields.description: Signed-magnitude or bounded integer limit for deflection command magnitude; final commands are clamped within this envelope.

registers.name: HISTORY_BASE
registers.description: Base selector for technology-neutral bulk history storage window, intended for mapping to block RAM.

fields.name: history_base
fields.description: History storage base address selector used by the memory wrapper and firmware-controlled access windowing.

registers.name: PAYLOAD_BASE
registers.description: Base selector for technology-neutral bulk payload storage window, intended for mapping to block RAM.

fields.name: payload_base
fields.description: Payload storage base address selector used by the memory wrapper and firmware-controlled access windowing.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Controller status and fault summary register readable by firmware.

fields.name: status_valid
fields.description: Indicates status information is valid for software consumption.

fields.name: fault_latched
fields.description: Latched fault indication from safety bounding logic.

fields.name: model_valid
fields.description: Model response valid indication reflected from transport activity.

fields.name: last_response_code
fields.description: Last response or validation status code captured by the safety stage.

registers.name: MODEL_REQ_DATA_SHADOW
registers.description: Read-only shadow of the current model-request payload for firmware inspection.

fields.name: model_req_data_shadow
fields.description: Lower 32 bits of the model-request data word staged by the transport engine.

registers.name: MODEL_RSP_DATA_SHADOW
registers.description: Read-only shadow of the current model-response payload for firmware inspection.

fields.name: model_rsp_data_shadow
fields.description: Lower 32 bits of the model-response data word captured by the transport engine.

init_sequence: Program HISTORY_BASE.history_base and PAYLOAD_BASE.payload_base as needed for memory windows.
Set CTRL.enable to 1 to allow transport and control operation.
polling_sequence: Read STATUS until status_valid is asserted and monitor fault_latched, model_busy, model_valid, timeout_active, stale_active, and last_response_code.
Read MODEL_REQ_DATA_SHADOW and MODEL_RSP_DATA_SHADOW for diagnostic visibility when needed.
If fault_latched is asserted, software should handle the fault condition and may issue CTRL.clear_fault as a write-one pulse after servicing the condition.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register map uses the mandatory firmware-visible MMIO/CSR interface and does not replace the streaming transport.
No fallback command, fallback register, fallback status, fallback controller, or fallback-on-reset behavior is introduced.
Bulk history/payload storage remains technology-neutral and memory-wrapper-backed rather than flattened into scalar registers.
